decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the building hereby permitted shall not be used as a service, storage, balcony, roof garden/amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - ? The building hereby approved shall be removed after a period of 3 years from the date of the permission and the site returned to its current clear level surface.
description: Erection of temporary single storey building to provide 32 bed ward and incorporating relocation of parking spaces
